limitations: Resistor-sheet models are DC only; surface bounds omit parallel copper conservatively.

Ideal plane source contacts exclude connector/cable resistance. Applying total input bound to the main positive copper path is a conservative high-current-mode approximation; detailed recovery-branch distribution is not modeled.
TPS2553 JEDEC RthetaJA is a package test-board metric, not a sealed-case thermal model.
BQ25616 input DPM uses max(4.3V,VBAT+0.2V) nominal; actual cable, switch and copper drops can reduce charge current. No fixed maximum charge-rate guarantee follows from this audit.
A first-order USB impedance estimate and physical DRC do not establish USB eye compliance or physical endurance.
